messages:
emma-cs: Hey team — customer (Acme Corp) says their promo code `CODEXFREE` is shown as active in the dashboard but the checkout API returns `invalid`. They hit this during invoice payment flow. Screenshot: https://files.acme/snap1.png

mike-eng: Can you paste the exact API request + response from the customer or from a repro?

emma-cs: Repro steps I used (customer email user+acme@example.com):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout/apply_promo \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_acme_123","promo":"CODEXFREE","amount":12000,"currency":"USD","scope":"invoice"}'
```
Response: 422, body:
```json
{"error":"promo_code_invalid","reason":"scope_mismatch","allowed_scopes":["seat","manual_credit"],"applied_scope":"invoice"}
```

mike-eng: Interesting — the API is explicit about scope_mismatch. Dashboard showing active probably comes from promo status only, not allowed scopes. @joyce-product any chance this promo was created as seat/manual-credit only?

joyce-product: I checked the promo config in the admin UI: `CODEXFREE` was created as a seat-based onboarding credit during last quarter. Creator notes: "applies to seats or manual credits only". It was never intended for invoice-level discounts. We probably need clearer labeling in the dashboard.

luis-qa: I can repro locally. The checkout endpoint enforces promo.allowed_scopes.includes(request.scope) now (PR 3421). The promo/status endpoint used by the console doesn't return allowed_scopes unless you call the verbose flag — that flag was accidentally removed in the UI query in release v1.8.2.

mike-eng: So root cause is twofold: 1) promo was configured seat/manual_credit only, 2) console no longer shows scope info by default so customers see "active" and assume applicable to invoice.

emma-cs: Customer was definitely trying to apply at invoice checkout. They pasted the dashboard screenshot and it literally shows "Active until 2026-10-01" with no scope. They escalated because checkout failed.

sophie-support: For now we offered a manual workaround: we can grant a manual credit to their billing account equal to the promo value. @billing-bot can you confirm the manual credit process?

billing-bot: To issue a manual credit: POST /admin/orgs/{org_id}/credits with body {"amount":12000, "currency":"USD", "reason":"manual promo grant: CODEXFREE"}. Requires billing-admin role. Example CLI: `rbilling credits create --org org_acme_123 --amount 12000 --reason "manual promo grant: CODEXFREE"`

luis-qa: Repro steps I ran to verify: applied same POST (scope=invoice) -> 422 scope_mismatch. Applied with scope=manual_credit -> 200 and promo applied to internal credit ledger.

mike-eng: Short-term actions:
- Support: issue manual credit using billing-bot command (Sophie) and confirm with customer.
- Eng: patch console to show promo.allowed_scopes on promo detail (hotfix PR) — I'll open a PR to include the verbose flag back into the UI call.
- Product: consider migration option to map seat promos to invoice if creator opted-in (product task). @joyce-product can you own that follow-up?

joyce-product: Yep, I'll create a JIRA to review mapping policy and UX. We should also add a small badge in the dashboard: "Applies to: Seats | Manual credits | Invoices".

emma-cs: Sophie — can you issue the manual credit and ping me when done? I'll tell the customer to retry checkout after we post the credit (they want immediate confirmation).

sophie-support: Done — issued manual credit of $120.00 USD to org_acme_123 at 2732109905. Receipt: https://billing.redwood/invoices/credit_98765. I messaged the customer and they confirmed their checkout succeeded right after. :white_check_mark:

mike-eng: I'll open the hotfix PR today (include console change + small telemetry event when promo UI lacks allowed_scopes).

joyce-product: Filed RW-7891 to evaluate mapping and UX improvements. Assigned to product team, priority P2.

emma-cs: Closing on my side — customer satisfied and we committed to the UI fix. Thanks everyone. :pray:
